detail.readback:
Welcome to the TinyMCE editor demo!

Meet TinyMCE, the Internet's most battle-tested rich text editor with over 60 features including: Advanced formatting, Export to and from Word and PDF, Accessibility and spelling checkers, Mentions and comments, and an AI assistant.

Sutradhar MCP baseline test.﻿

⭐️ Popular features (including paid subscription plugins)
Collaborate with @Mentions, discuss using Comments and review changes using Suggested Edits and keep an audit trail with Revision history.
Paste from MS Word and retain formatting. You can even import Word documents! 
Power your email editor with Merge tags and Inline CSS output.
Hit the highest standards with Spell Checker, Accessibility Checker, Advanced Typography and Link Checker.

🖖 Get TinyMCE
TinyMCE meets all your architecture requirements.
Cloud	Sign-up for free	Always up to date, easy to maintain
Self-hosted	Let's talk	With enterprise level support
Open source	Download today	Available under the GPLv2+ license
Why TinyMCE 👀
Out-of-the-box features save dev time. From tables and spell checking to full collaboration and accessibility compliance, TinyMCE offers features you’d otherwise spend months building.
Built to scale with you. TinyMCE powers applications with millions of users. Its performance, reliability, and architecture are built for scale, from early MVPs to global platforms.
Works where you build. Whether you're using React, Vue, Angular, or vanilla JavaScript—or embedding it in SaaS platforms or internal tools—TinyMCE integrates smoothly into your stack.
No one has been doing this longer. You benefit from 20+ years of stability, security, feature, accessibility, documentation improvements, and enterprise support services.

❤️ Go build something today
